judge.rationale: The candidate Appears to have stopped mid-task, leaving `.lore/dod.md` and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` tracked in the tree alongside unfinished work. Functionally, it compiles all schemas once at `register` time, which breaks the requirement that function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` definitions resolve and validate against the schema returned on each `execute` call (cached by schema reference). Furthermore, it misses the one-line JSDoc on `execute`, omits most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and leaves `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts` completely untouched. Finally, the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete and placed under `[Unreleased]` rather than matching the repo's convention.
